subject: Proposed new feature for TMB: simulating the fixed and/or random effects when simulate() is called.

messages.author: 00f2debfd588b763
messages.subject: Proposed new feature for TMB: simulating the fixed and/or random effects when simulate() is called.
parts:
The SIMULATE section of TMB can be used to simulate the observed data, making simulation analysis convenient. The function can be called with a set of parameters including the fixed and random effects otherwise it uses the previous estimates by default. Some diagnostics also involve simulating the fixed and/or random effects. This is done in VAST by using the function rmvnorm_prec(), which takes the MLEs and the jointPrecision from the standard deviation report and randomly samples the fixed and random effects from a multivariate normal, and passes these to the simulate() function call. It would be useful to integrate this functionality directly in the TMB simulate() function with an augment to determine if the random, fixed and random, or no parameters are simulated. In this way it could be used in any application without rewriting the code.

 

I am sure there may be some technical issue or possible improvements that would need to be considered.
